text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's New Year's Day and the start of Inari
One's
classic year.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's invited me to the beach with her
and her
friends to see the first sunrise.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Gurgle...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
This sucks. I don't know if it's because I
woke up
early, but I'm starting to get
pretty hungry.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Haha! It's a new year, but the same ol'
Oguri!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. ♪ I made some rice balls. Want to
eat them
later? I brought a thermos of
miso soup too.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: You did?!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Oguri's gonna Oguri 'n' Creek's gonna
Creek, I
guess. The sun'll rise anytime
now, so can I ask
y'all to sit tight a lil'
longer?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Sure, no problem.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
In any case, it's really exciting to watch
the first
sunrise of the year with
everyone like this, isn't
it? ♪

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I know, right? In a way, it's kinda
like a
festival ya can only experience on
New Year's
Day!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
The feeling in the air as the night slowly
turns into
morning somehow reminds me
of the starting
gate, just before a race
starts.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Ah, I know what ya mean! It really feels like that any-second-now kinda suspense!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Annnd, we're off! The sun's finally risin'!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. The first sunrise of the new year
and not a
cloud in the sky. A fittin' start
to our classic year.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
It feels like your soul is being cleansed,
doesn't
it?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Yeah. The start of a new year...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Listen up, Sun! Ya better not blink! This
year, I'll
be throwin' a festival so
dazzlin', it'll blind even
you!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Creek, Oguri... I really 'preciate ya
joinin' me
today.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Of course! ♪ Watching the sunrise with
everyone
has really got me motivated.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Sounds like you're also gonna blaze your
own trail
through your classic year, yeah,
Inari?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Yep. The races we're aimin' for might be
different,
but there's a chance we could
end up competin'
still.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Let's all do our best this year. And if we
have a
chance to race together,don't
hold anything
back.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Heck yeah! Let's all do our part to make
the
Twinkle Series really shine!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Boss. Thanks a bunch for stickin' by
me right
from the start of the year.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Boss. Thanks a bunch for stickin' by
me right
from the start of the year.
choice_data_list: 初日の出は毎年見に来ているのか？
初日の出は毎年見に来ているの？

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Well, not every single year. But this
time, I just
felt like juicin' things up!
Thought it'd be nice to
get the whole
gang together to watch it.
choice_data_list: 初日の出は毎年見に来ているのか？
初日の出は毎年見に来ているの？

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Right! Now that we're all inspired, wanna
head
back to the academy?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
...Oops! I almost forgot somethin' super

important, haha.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I know I've said this before, but I'm
lookin'
forward to another great year
with ya, Boss!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I know I've said this before, but I'm
lookin'
forward to another great year
with ya, Boss!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We head back to the academy and part
ways with
Oguri Cap and Super Creek.
After getting
changed, I meet up with
Inari One once more in
my office.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
All right then! Seein' as it's New Year's
Day and
we're sat here face-to-face,
how 'bout we do
somethin' festive?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
All right then! Seein' as it's New Year's
Day and
we're sat here face-to-face,
how 'bout we do
somethin' festive?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Ya gotta enjoy each season to the
fullest! That's
the coolest way to lift your
spirits!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Agreeing with her, I try to think of
something
good for New Year's...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Outta the gate right from the get-go, I
see! But
lemme warn ya, I'm as good as
they come!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Spinnin' tops, kite flyin', hagoita, karuta!
I've
played the heck out of 'em with the
folks back
home!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Izzat a challenge?! Bring it on!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sure enough, I come to learn the true
power of
Inari One, and we have a blast
playing New Year's
games.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Hah hah! I guess that's how a lotta folks
spend
New Year's Day! Ya always like to
sleep through
the holiday, Boss?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Hah hah! I guess that's how a lotta folks
spend
New Year's Day! Ya always like to
sleep through
the holiday, Boss?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Right-o, I got some mandarin oranges
from the
folks back home. Wanna have a
bite while we chill
out?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After that, Inari One and I get comfy
under the
kotatsu while enjoying some
tasty mandarins and
chatting about
nothing in particular.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Oh, a New Year's shrine visit! Good call!
After
greetin' the New Year's sun, we
should offer a
proper greetin' to the
gods too!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Alrighty then, that's the plan! No point
in
dawdlin'! Let's hightail it to the shrine!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Alrighty then, that's the plan! No point
in
dawdlin'! Let's hightail it to the shrine!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Following that, we head to the shrine
and pray for
her success in her classic
year.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Later, during our first training session of
the
year...

text_block_list.name: Male Reporter
text_block_list.text: Inari One is here!

text_block_list.name: Female Reporter
text_block_list.text:
I know you're very busy, but could we
have a
moment of your time?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Whazzat? Ya wanna interview me or
somethin'?

text_block_list.name: Male Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Yes, Inari One! You've shown fantastic
potential
since transferring from Oi. Tell
us, what are you
hoping to achieve in
your classic year?

text_block_list.name: Female Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Among your fans, there's a debate
raging about
whether you should focus
on turf or dirt races
now.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Ahh, gotcha. Ya wanna know what my
next steps
are gonna be. In that case,
the answer's simple.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
My next big goal is none other than the
Japan
Dirt Derby!

text_block_list.name: Male Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Wait, the Japan Dirt Derby?! As in
the Japan
Dirt Derby that's held at Oi
Racecourse?!

text_block_list.name: Female Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Does that mean your focus is not in the
centrals?
Or will you be competing
solely in dirt—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Annnd that's all ya get!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Talkin' like a blabbermouth isn't my
style. Sorry,
but you'll just have to see
what happens on the
track!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I gotta get back to trainin'! Catch y'all
later! And
hey, you're doin' a great job!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Right, let's head out, Boss. Can't sit
around any
longer!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Right, let's head out, Boss. Can't sit
around any
longer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After boldly declaring her goal, Inari
One begins
her classic year!
